context_policy: One new fork:none native consumer per frozen case; no prior conversation, source tree, producer context, reserved answers or judge responses. Every actual agent ID will be recorded after creation.
access_policy: Consumer uses a literal request/response bridge to original genesis-evaluation.ts index/read. No direct filesystem, browser, network, tools, memory or source access. Isolation is instruction-based, not an OS capability sandbox.
bridge_rules: Only the exact frozen question, optional frozen target, finite limits and port schema are supplied at dispatch.
The consumer chooses actual query objects. Root records the literal request and runs the unmodified CLI with the corresponding immutable candidate/generation/case policy.
Root forwards the complete original JSON stdout, stderr and exit status without editorial body changes or semantic hints.
Every attempt, including refusal, is retained. Durable per-case budget state is never reset or transplanted.
Root cannot supply a section title, answer or provenance from raw sources unless returned by the authorized reader.
The final response cites the versions/receipts actually returned and records abstentions.
The persistent independent pair evaluates C1 and its trace first; the remaining 13 cases then proceed with all original questions/oracles unchanged.
not_evidence: This plan does not constitute ADMIT, AC PASS, proof of read success or final acceptance.
